questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: In a sealed container, 30g of reactants react completely. What is the mass of the products?
questions.why: In a closed system, mass is conserved — the products must have the same total mass as the reactants, 30g.

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: What word describes a solid that suddenly forms when two liquids react?
